cases.construction: Offset root below nominal tabletop, collision face supported
cases.proposed_expectation: Full geometry/contact support remains; height-only alarm must not be used.

cases.construction: Tipped/sliding/overhanging object with maintained load-bearing table edge
cases.proposed_expectation: No fall solely from tip/slide; unresolved support remains unknown.
Keep direct/indirect distinct; applicability depends on the reviewed indirect-support scope.

cases.construction: Known initial support, support loss, descent, catch on a non-floor object
cases.proposed_expectation: Physical fall candidate remains despite arrest; floor is not required.

cases.construction: Continuous mechanically supported lift and stable surface transfer
cases.proposed_expectation: No unsupported descent; do not infer intention from the transfer.

cases.construction: Lifted object released before stable transfer and caught/returned to table
cases.proposed_expectation: Apply the explicitly reviewed table-origin-history choice, otherwise definition ambiguity.

cases.construction: Unknown initial support with later floor contact
cases.proposed_expectation: Insufficient information for applicability; no automatic pass or N/A.

cases.construction: Brief fall and recovery entirely between equal stored endpoints
cases.proposed_expectation: Cannot claim continuous absence from endpoint-only negative observations.

cases.construction: One finger touches an object while it descends
cases.proposed_expectation: Contact alone does not establish mechanical holding; preserve ambiguity without corroboration.

cases.construction: Anonymous native geometry IDs projected through a collapsed name list
cases.proposed_expectation: Reject legacy mapping; actual ID regression/error injection supplied separately.

cases.construction: Endpoint qpos paired with earlier contact geometry or delayed raw observations
cases.proposed_expectation: Fail phase/identity consistency or qualify fields; never use the mismatch as fall tolerance.

cases.construction: Event in the final unobserved physics interval or after execution termination
cases.proposed_expectation: Preserve boundary/coverage uncertainty; do not move an event into the requirement interval.
